articles.title: Behind-the-Scenes Star Wars Collection Appears Online
articles.summary: An unnamed buyer shared a collection of Phil Tippett’s film-effects archives, including behind-the-scenes Star Wars images and material from other movies.

articles.title: Nikola Bartunkova beats Aryna Sabalenka at China Open
articles.summary: Nikola Bartunkova beat world number two Aryna Sabalenka 6-4, 6-3 at the China Open and will face Sinja Kraus next.

articles.title: AI Coding Contest Reports a Rule-Breaking Move in StarCraft
articles.summary: Viewers reported that GPT-6 Astra used an existing bot during a StarCraft coding contest. The organizer restored its earlier code and let it continue.
